searchText: <@199561711278227457> Is there any plan to add eip7805 to dora? eip7805 blocks are not showing up on Dora because it doesn't recognize eip7805 version in `Eth-Consensus-Version` returned by `getBlock` beacon api. Currently I force Lodestar to return Electra version in order for it to show up on Dora. Not sure how prysm get around this We may have overloaded fulu for it to showed up or there's a Dora image somewhere I forgot cc <@845691100072509460> , i think he was looking into ILs and dora? Oh I'm on a different tasks at the moment. I was implementing beacon API to Prysm and am planning to move to Dora afterward. It would took quite some time for me to get back to it so if it's urgent please feel free to go for it. I've added go-eth2-client type so it should be straightforward. Wait, is it blocks not ILs? Looks like it's related to supporting `eip7805` fork? Delayed execution and delayed state_root are almost the same? Delayed execution is more general (i.e., it delays more than just state root validation: receipts and logs as well) Links: - Delayed execution: https://ethresear.ch/t/delayed-execution-and-skipped-transactions/21677 - Delayed state root: https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7862 FOCIL breakout session is today at 2pm UTC, we will discuss: - Research updates (zkFOCIL, FOCIL <> Delayed Execution and ePBS) - Progress tracker for FOCIL implementation milestones 👀 - Implementation updates + any other thing, feel free to add to the agenda: https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/1291 Today FOCIL is overlapping with PeerDAS 🥲 <@808969530608451584> fyi we use `eip7805` here https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/pull/490/files#diff-3cc6eaa800c1a4bd6adcd78f1722b466f7a24048a66e320c8f92872fbcd9eefbR160 right now **FOCIL Breakout 4** https://www.youtube.com/live/2MkoP6BDNro Where can I subscribe to the Ethereum calendar? https://calendar.google.com/calendar/u/0?cid=Y191cGFvZm9uZzhtZ3JtcmtlZ243aWM3aGs1c0Bncm91cC5jYWxlbmRhci5nb29nbGUuY29t are there already some early focil ready client images that I can use to test dora? 🙂 I wouldn't say ready, but you can try these: https://github.com/jihoonsong/local-devnet-focil/blob/main/kurtosis/kurtosis.config.registry.yaml#L4-L7 I've started a `eip7805-support` branch for dora. Docker image is `ethpandaops/dora:eip7805-support`. The kurtosis package automatically selects that image if nothing is specified via the config and eip7805 is scheduled for activation. So make sure to not override it with the master or any other image in the config 😉

Delayed execution is more general (i.e., it delays more than just state root validation: receipts and logs as well)

- Delayed state root: https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7862
